prompts.module-boiler:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production-ready transparent game equipment icon for Rain Match, a cute original workshop tile-matching roguelite.
Subject: OVERLOAD BOILER, a tiny living peach-coral pressure-pot creature. Its squat round body has a broad lower silhouette, two stubby dark-teal boots, tiny handle arms; its lid is cocked sideways like a jaunty beret. An oversized cream pressure gauge on its forehead has its needle in orange. Its face has two bold dark bean eyes, determined down-angled brows, pink cheek spots, and one tiny protruding buck tooth. It looks adorably overconfident, cheeks puffed as if holding a sneeze. One small soft cream steam puff curls from the lid. Distinctive charming character, an artisan collectible toy, memorable personality.
Style: tactile 3D clay storybook illustration, hand-sculpted rounded imperfect forms, velvety matte ceramic/plasticine, subtle hand-painted texture, restrained soft shading and gentle ambient occlusion. NOT flat vector art, NOT stock clip-art, NOT emoji. Broad shapes and facial features readable at 48 pixels. Warm coral, apricot cream, dark ink-teal with tiny brass accents. No intricate bolts, no busy decoration.
Composition: exactly ONE isolated full character, centered, front three-quarter view, fills 84% of a square canvas, all extremities inside image with even 8% transparent margin. No scene, no tile background, no border, no typography, no labels, no watermark. Genuine transparent background; only a very subtle small contact shadow. Original design, no recognizable existing game or franchise characters.
